nodes.description:
There is no treatment that restores ciliary function. For patients with respiratory symptoms, management is the supportive care used across primary ciliary dyskinesia: airway clearance and prompt treatment of respiratory infections. Nothing in it is specific to DNAH9.
In DNAH9 disease, respiratory signs are mild or absent in most reported patients, and the clinical picture is dominated by laterality defects and complex congenital heart disease. Airway care therefore applies to a minority of patients. The cardiac and laterality problems are managed as in other causes of heterotaxy and congenital heart disease, and that management is not curated here.
